integrity: A general algebraic eight-profile proof is supplied; finite checks are expressly supplemental. Verification code and recorded output are included. Independent scientific review is not represented as performed.
limitations: The theorem is confined to nontrivial finite dicyclic groups with parameter n>=2 in the equality/identity/ternary multiplication language, at first-order quantifier rank exactly at most two. It does not concern the functional group language or higher ranks. An equivalent claim in unindexed historical literature is possible.
title: Seven two-round theories of finite dicyclic groups
